## Outcome

Explain the change and link the relevant issue or roadmap outcome.

## Validation

List commands run and their results, including any skipped checks and why.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Source identity, evidence routes and qualified relationships are preserved.
- [ ] New examples and tests are original and clearly synthetic.
- [ ] No private research, credentials, local paths or private Git history added.
- [ ] CLI, agent discovery and documentation agree.
- [ ] Public-tree check and applicable regression tests pass.
- [ ] Contract changes and migration implications are documented.
